title: Customer Care Note: Kestrel GAP Waivers Held on Several Finance Contracts
content:
# Customer Care Note — Kestrel GAP Waivers Held on Several Finance Contracts

**Rule.** A borrower may hold Kestrel GAP Waiver addenda on several finance contracts. There is no limit on the number of waivers per customer. Each finance contract, however, may carry only one waiver, under the one-waiver-per-finance-contract rule.

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Is there a maximum number of Kestrel GAP Waivers one customer may hold? | No — no per-customer limit applies. |
| Is the limit counted per customer or per finance contract? | Per finance contract: one waiver per contract. |

**Example (hypothetical).** A repeat buyer who financed two vehicles on two separate Kestrel Auto Finance contracts may hold one Kestrel GAP Waiver on each contract — two waivers in total. A third financed purchase on a third contract could carry a third waiver; the count per customer is not limited. The same customer cannot hold two waivers on one of those contracts.
